generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Submit the details of List of existing commitments and ongoing work
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value Min Rs.500/- or & Max Rs.7500/- or soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

As per Karnataka state Government order No. LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards labour welfare fund and contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act.

Tenderer shall obtain the Work Done Certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer District Level Officer and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the bid.
Financial year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty First day of March of succeeding year both days inclusive
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall scan the original ownership documents/lease/hire commitment agreement for the machineries and attach the scanned file to the bid
The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all tenders without assigning any reasons
Royalty Charges will be Deducted in every bill of contract as per rules
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

All safety precautions warning signs night illumination reflectors deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. The contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The Item Rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials & other taxes excluding GSTas per the rates prevailing Government Orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all leads and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery & equipment etc., complete and all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of work.
Tenderer who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value.
All Materials required for this work shall be procured by the bidder himself and should got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on the work
To qualify for award of this contract each bidder should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-3 KPWD and further orders thereon
Period for completion of work is 6 Months (Excluding monsoon)
Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit for an amount 5% of the Contract price.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section
LOC or Letter of Credit should be in prescribed format as per KW-3 Bid Document
The Tenderer should be a PWD Registered class III & above contractor

The Earnest Money Deposit Rs. 1,26,000.00 shall be in two parts (1) Rs. 50,000.00 by e-payment Part (2) Balance EMD of Rs. 76,000.00 EMD shall be in favor of Executive Engineer PWD Division Karwar and may be in the form of Bank Guarantee issued by Nationalized/Scheduled Bank in favor of Executive Engineer PWD Division Karwar Contractor should upload the scanned Copy of issued by Nationalized or Scheduled Bank
Only relevant document needs to be uploaded. Un-necessary documents or any kind of fake documents will lead to rejection of tender
Terms and conditions as per KW-3
Any deviation / error / mistake found in units of items they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 and the rates shall be quoted accordingly
The Estimate rates are exclusive of 18% GST
Star rates are not applicable
GST will be paid as per the present rates at 18%, if GST revises (Increases or Decreases) same shall be paid accordingly as per the Govt Circular No. FD 417 EXP-12/2024 Dtd:09.08.2024

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26. Achieved in at least Two Financial years an Average annual financial turnover Rs. 62.54 Lakhs (Turnover certificate without UDIN number is Treated Non Responsive)

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 satisfactorily completed at least 50 percent of the contract value as prime contractor at least one similar work such as Construction of Bridge Work of value not less than Rs. 31.27 Lakhs

Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 18.76 lakhs (in prescribed format)(credit lines/letter of credit/certificate from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc in prescribed format otherwise tender will be rejected)
This bid documents clause No. 34.4 to be implemented as per delegation of power vide GO No. 423 FC-1 2018 Bangalore dated 24.09.2018
EMD Payments through e-payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in multiple Transaction are liable for rejection

The Project completion period is 6 months and the Tenderer should maintain work during the defect liability period which is (1) One Year after successful completion of the workTechnical Qualification Criteria

itemList.description:
Mechanical Means -
Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means  for all   works   & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including setting out,     shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,     including  dressing  of excavated  surfaces,  disposing  off  or  levelling  the  excavated  earth  or  sorting &   stacking the selected   earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m  including  cost  of  labour,  tools,  usage  of  machinery  &  other  appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 3 m ---- DTS

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- DTS

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete   for all Foundation   works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers  laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators,   including all lead & lifts,   cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of   relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery,   curing and all the other   appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - M 25   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- DTS

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete   for  all  Sub  structures  of building,  Irrigation  works,  Sub  structure  works  of  bridges,  Drain  works    & other  parallel  works  from  0.50m  to  3.50  m  height.  The  granite/trap/basalt crushed  graded  coarse  aggregates    and  fine  aggregates    as  per  relevant  IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers,   laid in layers, well compacted using needle   vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of   relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - M 25   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- DTS

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete   for all Super structures of building , Road works, Water works, Irrigation works & super structure works of bridges  upto 3.50 m height. The  granite/trap/basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers laid in layers, well compacted using needle   vibrators. The cost  includes  all  lead  &  lifts,   cost  of  all  materials,  quality  confirming  to  the requirements of  relevant IS codes , labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and  all  other  appurtenances  required  to  complete  the  work  as  per  technical specifications. - M 25   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- DTS

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. Foundations of Bridges ---- DTS

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. Sub structure of Bridges ---- DTS

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. Super structure of Bridges ---- DTS

Providing and laying of Filter media with granular materials/ stone   crushed   aggregates   satisfying   the   requirements   laid down in clause 2504.2.2. of MoRTH specifications to a thickness of  not  less  than  600  mm  with  smaller  size  towards  the  soil and bigger size towards the wall and provided over the entire surface behind abutment, wing wall and return wall to the full height compacted to a firm condition complete as per drawing and Technical Specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 710.1.4. of IRC :78 & 2200 ---- DTS

Back   filling   behind   abutment,   wing   wall   and   return   wall complete  including  compaction  as  per  drawing  and  Technical Specification - Granular material. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 710.1.4. of IRC :78 & 2200 ---- DTS
Drainage Spouts using 100 mm GI pipe complete as per drawing and Technical specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2705 ---- DTS
Providing and laying Cement concrete wearing coat M-30 grade including reinforcement complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications. (Batching Plant). Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2702 ---- DTS

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Painting Two Coats on New Concrete Surfaces - Painting  two  coats  after  filling  the  surface  with  synthetic enamel paint in all shades on new plastered concrete surfaces. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 803 ---- DTS

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Providing  and  fixing  RCC  name  board  of  size  1.35x0.60x0.04 m    fixed    in    reinforced    cement    concrete    poles    of    size 0.10x0.10x2.60m  in  cement  concrete  M  20  proportion  using 20mm   and   down   size   graded   metal   machine   mixed   with 10mm  dia  main  steel  bars  and  8mm  dia  stirpes  as  shown  in drawing. The board shall be provided with 12mm thick cement plaster in cement mortar 1:4 on both the sides. The poles shall be embedded in the ground for a depth of 0.5 m with cement concrete M 10 proportion. The board shall be fixed as per the drawing and at the place indicated by the Engineer in charge of the work. The cost includes excavation, cost of all materials, cost  of  steel,  painting,  centering,  transportation  charges  & fixing charges. ---- DTS

Mechanical Means -
Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground for all  works other than foundation in all kinds of soils & upto depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical   specifications, including setting out,   shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting &  stacking the selected  earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils upto 300 mm depth ---- DTS

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Granular Sub-Base - By Mix in Place Method - Construction  of  Granular  Sub-Base  of  required  grading  as  per design     spreading   in   uniform   layers   with   motor   grader   on prepared surface mixing by mix in place method with front end loader at OMC and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density, complete as per clause 401 - For Grading -II Material. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 401 ---- DTS

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406 ---- DTS

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Providing  and  constructing     un-reinforced  plain  cement concrete pavement, thickness as per design, over a prepared sub  base,  with  43  grade  cement  or  any  other  type  as  per Clause  1501.2.2  M30  (Grade),  coarse  and  fine  aggregates conforming   to   IS:383:2016:,   maximum   size   of   coarse aggregate not exceeding 25 mm, mixed in a concrete mixer of  not  less  than  0.2  cum  capacity  and  appropriate  weigh batcher using approved mix design,   laid in approved fixed side formwork (steel channel, laying and fixing of 125 micron thick polythene film, wedges, steel plates including levelling the formwork as per drawing), spreading the concrete with shovels,  rakes,  compacted  using  needle,  screed  and  plate vibrators  and  finished  in  continuous  operation  including construction joints, primer, sealant, curing of concrete slabs for  14-days,  and  water  finishing  to  lines  and  grade  as  per drawing    and  technical  specification  clause  1501  with  all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete.  as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1501 ---- DTS

Manual Means -
Construction  of  Embankment  by  excavating  the  available  approved  Gravel/ Murrum deposited at a place or borrow pits during or prior excavation with all lifts and lead, transportation to site, spreading, grading to required slope and compacting to meet the requirement complete as per specifications, including cost of labour,rolling,water,all materials,usage& all other appurtenaces required to complete the work. ---- DTS
